amqp_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the AMQP server (e.g., 'rabbitmq.example.com' or '10.0.0.5')

amqp_port.description: TCP port of the AMQP server (5672 for AMQP 0-9-1, 5671 for AMQPS/TLS)

amqp_password.description: Password for AMQP authentication. Leave blank to use the `AMQP_PASSWORD` environment variable at runtime.

amqp_use_tls.description: Enable TLS/SSL encryption for AMQP connections

amqp_ca_cert_path.description: Path to CA certificate file for TLS verification (required if using custom/enterprise CA)

amqp_client_cert_path.description: Path to client certificate file (for mutual TLS auth)

amqp_client_key_path.description: Path to client private key file (for mutual TLS auth)

amqp_protocol_version.description: TLS protocol version (e.g., 'TLSv1.2'). Leave empty to use system default.

amqp_connection_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for connection establishment

amqp_retry_max.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for transient failures

default_exchange.description: Default exchange name to use when none is specified in commands (e.g., 'amq.direct')

default_routing_key.description: Default routing key for publish operations (ignored for fanout exchanges)

default_message_ttl.description: Default message TTL in milliseconds (0 means no TTL)

queues.description: List of queues to ensure exist (declared at startup)

auto_delete.description: Queue is deleted when last consumer unsubscribes

exclusive.description: Queue is exclusive to the current connection

exchanges.description: List of exchanges to ensure exist

auto_delete.description: Exchange is deleted when last binding is removed

internal.description: If true, exchange cannot be published to directly (only used for inter-exchange routing)

id.description: Unique identifier for this binding (used as section header)
